domains.name: Recipe Crafting
domains.promise: Members combine play-money-economy inventory materials into new virtual items with /craft against a seeded recipe book they browse with /recipes; ingredient consumption is strictly atomic so a craft either spends every listed material and produces its output exactly once or refunds every consumed material with no partial spend, an atomic per-member cooldown paces crafting, and the whole loop lives inside the fake game economy — crafted items are virtual, never real commerce goods.

controls.description: Master switch mapped to the economy_crafting_enabled guild_config key; when off, /craft and /recipes explain crafting is not enabled and no inventory changes.
Fallback crafting cooldown in seconds mapped to the economy_crafting_cooldown_seconds guild_config key; applies to recipes that do not carry their own per-recipe cooldown_seconds.

defaults.rationale: Crafting is a flagship game-economy loop and ships on for the maximal out-of-box experience; owners can switch it off at any time from the dashboard.
A conservative one-minute fallback cooldown paces crafting without punishing casual players; matches the economy_crafting_cooldown_seconds column default and is fully owner-tunable up to a day.

permissions.enforcement: Crafting slash commands respond for every member; /craft only ever reads and mutates the invoking member's own inventory rows keyed to their user id.

permissions.actor: Dashboard user with owner or admin access to the guild
permissions.action: Edit crafting settings on the dashboard economy crafting page
permissions.enforcement: Dashboard session auth plus Supabase RLS restrict guild_config writes to authorized guild administrators.

permissions.action: Consume another member's inventory materials through a craft
permissions.enforcement: Every /craft handler resolves inventory and the atomic economy_decrement_inventory RPC by the invoking member's own user id; no code path decrements another member's inventory.

messages.trigger: A member successfully crafts a recipe
messages.audience: The crafting member and the channel
messages.defaultTemplate: You crafted {output-qty}x {recipe-name}, {member-name}! Your materials were spent and the item is in your inventory.

messages.trigger: A member runs /craft without enough ingredients
messages.defaultTemplate: You don't have enough materials to craft {recipe-name} yet, {member-name}: {missing-list}.

messages.trigger: A member runs /craft while their crafting cooldown is still active
messages.defaultTemplate: Easy there, {member-name} — you can craft again in {wait-time}.

messages.trigger: A craft consumed ingredients but a later step failed, so every consumed ingredient was refunded
messages.defaultTemplate: That craft didn't complete, {member-name} — every material for {recipe-name} was refunded to your inventory. Try again.

messages.trigger: The crafting backend is temporarily unreachable when a member runs a crafting command
messages.surface: Ephemeral reply to the invoking member
messages.defaultTemplate: The workbench is catching its breath, {member-name} — give it a moment and try again.

messages.trigger: Crafting output writes keep failing for the guild and members are being auto-refunded
messages.defaultTemplate: Heads up: crafting for {recipe-name} keeps failing to finalize and members are being auto-refunded; nothing was double-spent and everything is logged.

values.description: The member has no craft in flight and no active cooldown; /craft and /recipes are ready.
A /craft is executing: the atomic cooldown lock is held and ingredients are being decremented atomically before the output is written.
The member crafted recently; the atomic per-member cooldown lock is held and further /craft calls are refused until it expires.
A craft failed mid-way; every already-consumed ingredient was refunded exactly once, no output was produced, and the member was notified.
Crafting disabled by configuration; /craft and /recipes explain the feature is off and no inventory changes.

transitions.trigger: Member runs /craft for a recipe they can afford with no active cooldown
transitions.expectedEffect: An atomic SET PX NX cooldown lock is acquired and each listed ingredient is decremented atomically via economy_decrement_inventory.

transitions.trigger: Every ingredient decrement and the output economy_upsert_inventory succeed
transitions.expectedEffect: The output item is added to the member's inventory exactly once, a craft transaction is recorded, quest progress is tracked, and the cooldown lock holds.

transitions.trigger: An ingredient decrement or the output upsert fails part-way through the craft
transitions.expectedEffect: Every already-consumed ingredient is refunded exactly once via economy_upsert_inventory, no output is produced, and no partial spend persists.

transitions.trigger: Member runs /craft again before the cooldown lock expires
transitions.expectedEffect: The branded cooldown message replies with the remaining wait, no ingredient is consumed, and no output is produced.

transitions.trigger: The per-member cooldown window elapses after a successful craft
transitions.expectedEffect: The cooldown lock expires and /craft is available again.

transitions.trigger: The per-member cooldown window set at craft start elapses after a refunded craft
transitions.expectedEffect: The cooldown lock expires and /craft is available again with the refunded materials intact.

transitions.trigger: Owner turns economy_crafting_enabled off on the dashboard
transitions.expectedEffect: /craft and /recipes reply with the disabled explanation; recipe and inventory rows are preserved untouched.
Crafting resumes with the seeded recipe book and all prior inventory intact.

failures.trigger: A mid-consume economy_decrement_inventory call fails because another action spent the material first
failures.expectedBehavior: Every already-consumed ingredient is refunded exactly once via economy_upsert_inventory, no output is produced, the member is told to retry, and no partial spend is left behind.

failures.trigger: The economy_upsert_inventory call for the crafted output fails after ingredients were consumed
failures.expectedBehavior: All consumed ingredients are refunded exactly once, no output is added, the member sees the refund notice, and if these output writes keep failing the owner is alerted once.

failures.trigger: Supabase is unreachable when a member runs /craft or /recipes
failures.expectedBehavior: The command replies with the branded crafting-unavailable message, no inventory or cooldown mutation occurs, the outage raises a single owner degradation alert, and a fresh craft after recovery consumes exactly once.

evidence.observer: Discord observer client joined to the primary test guild
evidence.expectedObservation: Crafting behavior contracted here is directly observed working in the live test guild: /recipes lists the seeded recipe book, /craft consumes exactly the listed ingredients and adds the output to inventory, an insufficient craft is refused, a mid-craft failure refunds every material, and the per-member cooldown paces repeat crafts.

evidence.observer: Supabase service-role SQL probe paired with anon and second-guild RLS probe clients
evidence.expectedObservation: The economy_recipes, economy_inventory, economy_items, economy_transactions, and guild_config rows enforce guild-scoped row-level security: the service role sees scenario rows while anon and cross-guild clients see none.

evidence.observer: Audit-log table reader using the service role
evidence.expectedObservation: Every state change in this domain lands exactly one append-only audit row with actor, guild, and correlation id; anonymization, never deletion, is the only mutation observed.

evidence.observer: Owner alert channel observer in the primary test guild
evidence.expectedObservation: This domain's failure branches raise exactly one owner alert carrying a human-readable reason and remediation hint; happy paths raise none.

evidence.observer: Embed and message snapshot inspector comparing captures against the configured brand kit
evidence.expectedObservation: Captured embeds and messages for this domain match the owner's white-label brand kit and configured voice preset, including the subtle powered-by-SomniBot attribution.

evidence.observer: Event re-delivery harness with a duplicate detector over ingredient consumption, crafted output, and craft transactions
evidence.expectedObservation: Replaying recorded craft triggers for this domain against the live stack leaves end state unchanged: the atomic per-member cooldown lock rejects the duplicate within its window so ingredients are consumed once and output produced once.

evidence.observer: Post-run resource sweeper diffing run-prefixed inventory before and after the suite
evidence.expectedObservation: After the suite a sweep of the test guilds and database finds no run-prefixed resources from this domain remaining anywhere.

assertions.expectedObservation: /recipes shows the seeded recipe book grouped by category, /craft "Iron Bar" replies with the branded crafted embed while inventory drops by exactly 4 Iron Ore and gains exactly 1 Iron Bar, and an immediate repeat /craft returns the branded cooldown message with the remaining wait.

The owner alert channel receives no alert on this scenario's happy path and exactly one reasoned alert whenever the scenario exercises a failure branch.
Every member-facing crafting surface in this scenario shows the owner's configured brand name, colors, and voice preset with the subtle powered-by-SomniBot attribution and zero stock-bot wording.

Re-delivering this scenario's craft events yields no duplicate ingredient consumption, crafted output, or craft transactions; the atomic per-member cooldown lock shows exactly one effect per logical craft.
